about_the_game:
This downloadable content includes a single avatar fully compatible with Animaze, featuring both ARKit-based and standard facial tracking support.

Sludgekin is a quirky and expressive avatar, inspired by the idea of a toxic pillow that survived a nuclear attack. It is designed to bring humor and emotion into any virtual space, with a wide range of facial expressions and smooth animations.

Every part of Sludgekin can be customized. You can change the colors, add props like hats, glasses, headphones, and create a unique look that fits your style.

Sludgekin works perfectly in Animaze for streaming, video chats, games, and virtual meetings. It is a fun and versatile choice for anyone who wants to stand out and add personality to their digital presence.

Features

  • Facial Animations
    Includes a standard set of facial animations for use with the Mediapipe tracker, as well as an ARKit-specific set designed for iPhone tracking. Both options provide smooth, expressive facial performance.

  • Color Customizations
    Every part of the avatar supports extensive color customization, offering users full creative freedom to match their personal style.

  • Props Attachment Slots
    Equipped with slots for a wide variety of props, including:

    • Hat

    • Mustache

    • Earphones

    • Glasses

    • Holdables

    • Carryables

  • Full Body Tracking
    Compatible with Axis Neuron for full-body tracking, ensuring dynamic and lifelike performance.

  • Special Actions
    Features special actions retargeted from Animaze’s mannequin, enhancing the character’s versatility.

Includes 2 backgrounds with light setup: Toxic environment and Studio Podcast
